Some are looking to build closer ties to offset rising American tariffs, while others simply still value EU-China trade despite growing friction
4 -MIN READ 4 -MIN 1 Listen Sherry Wang in Beijing Published: 4:00pm, 1 Nov 2026 While trade tensions between Beijing and Brussels remain elevated, some European businesses are pointing to disruptions from the United States as a bigger challenge.
Instead, they are seeking closer cooperation with China, even as Chinese carmakers scramble to front-load exports ahead of potential future trade barriers.
At last week’s 19th Europe-China Business and Technology Cooperation Fair in the southwestern Chinese city of Chengdu, the appetite for closer business ties was evident.
